checks.name: Check that field 'transaction_id' is present
checks.implementation: column 'transaction_id' exists in erp_transactions

checks.name: Check that field transaction_id has physical type varchar
checks.implementation: physical type of 'transaction_id' is 'varchar'

checks.name: Check that field transaction_id has no missing values
checks.implementation:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN "t0"."transaction_id" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "erp_transactions__transaction_id__field_required"
FROM "erp_transactions" AS "t0"

checks.name: Check that unique field transaction_id has no duplicate values
checks.implementation:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    "t0"."transaction_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "_dup_n"
  FROM "erp_transactions" AS "t0"
  GROUP BY
    1
) AS "t1"
WHERE
  "t1"."_dup_n" > 1

checks.name: Check that field transaction_id has a max length of 30
checks.implementation:
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN NOT (
        "t0"."transaction_id" IS NULL
      )
      AND NOT (
        LENGTH("t0"."transaction_id") <= 30
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS "erp_transactions__transaction_id__field_max_length"
FROM "erp_transactions" AS "t0"
